decision_statement: Send invoice INV-2026-0912 of 4,800.00 EUR to customer C-4471 for order O-20261103-18, under the outbound-invoices policy of 1 October 2026, through the customer API.
context_at_decision: Order O-20261103-18 was delivered on 3 November 2026; the invoicing agent prepared the invoice and the policy requires the finance controller's confirmation above 1,000.00 EUR.
options_considered: Hold it for the monthly batch: 26 days later.
Split it in two: the customer did not ask for it.
assumptions_depended_on: The delivery of 3 November 2026 is complete and accepted.
success_criteria: One invoice of 4,800.00 EUR accepted by the customer API, and no second one for the same order.

consent_posture.posture_class: contract performance: invoicing of a delivered order

affirmation_record.method: Ed25519 signature over the DPS person_approval assertion

mode_classification_attestation.attestation_text_signed: I attest that this decision record was dispatched in mode-1 with an embedded mode-2 summary under charter CH-EXAMPLE-INVOICING-1: the invoicing agent (invoicing-assistant, version 2) drafted the invoice from order O-20261103-18; I reviewed it as shown in the finance console, approved the specification whose digest the attachment names, and I am the accountable owner of this decision.

re_decision_trigger: The customer disputes the delivery before the invoice is sent.
